extraction_notes: Main-text performance figures digitised: Figures 10–17. Characterisation figures (1–9) and DFT/simulation figures (18–20) were skipped. CO2 conversion is not plotted in the main-text performance figures. Figure 16 uses contact time on the x-axis, which has no dedicated schema field; the contact time is recorded in notes for each point. Figure 13 caption temperature conflicts with nearby discussion text; the discussion states the In-loading series was at constant 250 °C, which is used here. All plotted values are approximate ('~') from marker/bar positions.
